title.zh: 黄仁勋被英伟达董事会重新任命为 CEO
title.en: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO

summary.zh: 英伟达董事会恢复黄仁勋总裁、CEO 与董事职务，立即生效，距其辞职约两周；特朗普称曾与董事会沟通并认为其未做错事，黄仁勋预计下周出席参议院听证。
summary.en: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO and board member, effective immediately, about two weeks after his resignation. Donald Trump said he spoke with the board and that Huang did nothing wrong; Huang is scheduled to testify in the Senate next week.

why.zh: 关系全球 AI 芯片龙头的治理与美国出口管制走向。
why.en: Bears on governance at the leading AI chip maker and on US export-control policy.

title.zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Ship，让 AI 智能体审查、修复并批准代码改动

summary.zh: Anthropic 推出面向工程师的 Claude Ship，Claude 可自行审查拉取请求并提交修复，目标是缓解 AI 生成代码堆积造成的审批瓶颈。
summary.en: Anthropic launched Claude Ship, in which Claude can review pull requests and ship fixes on its own, aiming to remove the approval bottleneck created by piles of AI-generated code.

why.zh: 把 AI 编码从写代码推进到代码评审与合并环节。
why.en: Moves AI coding from writing code into review and merge.

sources.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
Claude AI can review pull requests and ship fixes on its own now

title.zh: 智谱 Z.ai 发布 GLM-5.4，首个采用循环 Transformer 的旗舰模型
title.en: Z.ai releases GLM-5.4, its first flagship looped transformer

summary.zh: GLM-5.4 为 7500 亿参数旗舰，将 28 层各运行两次的循环架构，Z.ai 称借此提升通用编码能力。
summary.en: GLM-5.4 is a 750B-parameter flagship that runs its 28 layers twice in a loop architecture, which Z.ai says improves generalized coding.

why.zh: 循环架构在国产旗舰模型上落地，值得关注效率与能力取舍。
why.en: A looped architecture reaches a flagship Chinese model; watch the efficiency and capability trade-off.

sources.title: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer
Z.ai follows OpenAI into loop transformer territory with its new 750B flagship model

title.zh: OpenAI 公布 GPT 系列内部困惑度曲线，呼吁同行商定共同训练上限
title.en: OpenAI publishes its internal GPT perplexity curve and urges rivals to agree on shared limits

summary.zh: OpenAI 首席科学家 Jakub Pachocki 首次公开整个 GPT 系列的内部困惑度分数，含一款未发布模型，并警告后续系统可能超过安全检查速度，提议业界共同限速。
summary.en: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki released internal perplexity scores for the whole GPT series, including an unreleased model, warned that upcoming systems could outpace safety checks, and urged rivals to agree on shared limits.

why.zh: 头部实验室首次公开训练进展并公开谈论限速。
why.en: A leading lab opens its training progress and publicly raises speed limits.

sources.title: [AINews] Jensen Is Back! and OpenAI Shows Its Pretraining Curve, joined by Microsoft
OpenAI warns that upcoming AI systems could outpace safety checks and urges rivals to agree on shared limits
OpenAI’s chief scientist has thoughts on how to limit AI development

title.zh: GPT-6.2 Sol 成为 ChatGPT 对话页默认模型
title.en: GPT-6.2 Sol becomes the default model in ChatGPT's chat tab

summary.zh: OpenAI 在全球推出 GPT-6.2 Sol 作为 ChatGPT 对话页默认模型，称复杂日常问题、网页搜索与图像理解更可靠。
summary.en: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6.2 Sol worldwide as the default model in ChatGPT's chat tab, saying it handles complex everyday questions, web search and images more reliably.

why.zh: 直接影响数亿 ChatGPT 用户的默认体验。
why.en: Changes the default experience for ChatGPT's large user base.

sources.title: OpenAI updates ChatGPT to handle complex everyday questions, web searches, and images more reliably

title.zh: GPT-6.2 Astra 独立给出 Smoktunowicz 间隙定理的可机器验证 Lean 证明
title.en: GPT-6.2 Astra produces a machine-verifiable Lean proof of Smoktunowicz's gap theorem

summary.zh: 据 Vals AI，OpenAI 的 GPT-6.2 Astra 独立生成了该定理的 Lean 形式化证明，并自创证明策略，其他 AI 此前未能做到。
summary.en: According to Vals AI, OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra independently produced a Lean proof of the theorem and invented its own proof strategy, which no other AI had managed.

why.zh: 形式化数学是检验 AI 推理能力的硬指标。
why.en: Formal mathematics is a hard test of AI reasoning.

sources.title: GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy

title.zh: 多州起诉 SpaceX，指 Grok 生成儿童性影像与报复性色情
title.en: US states sue SpaceX over Grok generating child sexual images and revenge porn

summary.zh: 多个州总检察长，包括俄勒冈与弗吉尼亚，起诉 SpaceX，称 Grok 仍在生成违法图像；X 称每条输出都经过筛查。
summary.en: State attorneys general, including Oregon and Virginia, sued SpaceX saying Grok still generates illegal images; X says every Grok output is screened.

why.zh: 生成式 AI 内容安全的监管与诉讼压力继续升级。
why.en: Regulatory and legal pressure on generative-AI content safety keeps rising.

sources.title: States sue SpaceX to stop Grok from generating child sex images, revenge porn
Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX over Grok’s porn deepfakes

title.zh: 亚马逊据报以 75 亿美元收购 Decart 的 AI 优化技术
title.en: Amazon reportedly acquires Decart's AI optimization tech for $7.5B

summary.zh: 亚马逊将收购 Decart 的 AI 优化技术与研究团队，据报金额 75 亿美元，为其对外销售 Trainium 芯片做准备。
summary.en: Amazon is acquiring Decart's AI optimization technology and research team in a reported $7.5 billion deal as it prepares to sell Trainium chips.

why.zh: 显示云厂商正补强自研芯片的软件栈以对抗英伟达。
why.en: Shows cloud providers building software around their own chips to challenge Nvidia.

sources.title: Amazon snaps up Decart’s AI optimization tech for $7.5B as it prepares to sell Trainium chips

title.zh: DeepMind 用智能体团队与形式化验证改进量子算法
title.en: DeepMind uses agent teams and formal verification to improve quantum algorithms

summary.zh: Google DeepMind 用智能体团队结合形式化验证，改进面向聚变与化学的量子算法。
summary.en: Google DeepMind used agent teams with formal verification to improve quantum algorithms for fusion and chemistry.

why.zh: 智能体加形式化验证正成为科研发现的通用套路。
why.en: Agents plus formal verification are becoming a pattern for scientific discovery.

sources.title: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification

title.zh: OpenAI 与思科推出开源 Linux 运行时 Shirudo
title.en: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source Linux runtime

summary.zh: Shirudo 是面向 Linux 的开源运行时，帮助团队在推出补丁期间保护运行中的系统。
summary.en: Shirudo is an open-source runtime for Linux that helps teams protect running systems while rolling out patches.

why.zh: AI 公司开始进入基础设施安全工具领域。
why.en: AI companies are moving into infrastructure security tooling.

sources.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo

title.zh: Sierra 完成 17.5 亿美元 F 轮融资，估值翻倍至 300 亿美元
title.en: Sierra raises $1.75B Series F, doubling its valuation to $30B

summary.zh: 由 Bret Taylor 联合创立的客户体验 AI 公司 Sierra 宣布融资 17.5 亿美元，六个月内估值翻倍至 300 亿美元。
summary.en: Sierra, the customer-experience AI company co-founded by Bret Taylor, raised $1.75 billion and doubled its valuation to $30 billion within six months.

why.zh: 企业客服智能体需求持续高涨。
why.en: Demand for enterprise customer-service agents keeps climbing.

sources.title: Sierra doubles valuation to $30B within six months as demand for AI in CX takes off

title.zh: Anthropic 对算力的需求推动 xAI 转向租赁而非自建
title.en: Anthropic's compute demand pushes xAI toward renting over building

summary.zh: 报道称自 5 月起 SpaceXSI 向 Anthropic 与 Google 等对手出租算力并缩减自有 AI 项目，Anthropic 每年支付约 31 亿美元。
summary.en: Per the report, since May SpaceXSI has rented compute to rivals such as Anthropic and Google while scaling back its own AI projects; Anthropic pays about $3.1 billion.

why.zh: 算力供需正在重塑实验室之间的竞合关系。
why.en: Compute supply and demand is reshaping lab competition and cooperation.

sources.title: Anthropic's appetite for compute is pushing xAI toward a rent-over-build strategy

title.zh: 新基准显示 AI 编码代理在模拟职场中完成任务不足十分之一
title.en: New benchmark: AI coding agents complete under one in ten tasks in a simulated workplace

summary.zh: 新测试把编码代理放进有同事、项目看板和不完整交接的模拟开发岗位，代理在孤立测试中表现好，但完成的任务不到十分之一。
summary.en: A new test puts coding agents in a simulated developer job with colleagues, project boards and incomplete handoffs; they ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten tasks.

why.zh: 提醒基准分数与真实协作场景之间仍有差距。
why.en: A reminder that benchmark scores still trail real collaborative work.

sources.title: AI coding agents ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten tasks in a simulated workplace

title.zh: Meta 的 Alexandr Wang 称黎曼猜想的 AI 辅助证明草图说明超级智能临近
title.en: Meta's Alexandr Wang says the AI-assisted Riemann proof sketch signals superintelligence is near

summary.zh: Meta 首席 AI 官 Alexandr Wang 认为近期黎曼猜想的 AI 辅助证明草图表明超级智能已近在眼前，并警告行业尚未准备好。
summary.en: Meta Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang sees the recent AI-assisted proof sketch of the Riemann Hypothesis as a sign superintelligence is close, and warns the industry isn't ready.

why.zh: 反映业界领袖对近期进展的判断，属个人观点。
why.en: Reflects an industry leader's reading of recent progress; this is opinion.

sources.title: Meta's Alexandr Wang warns the AI industry isn't ready for what's coming after Riemann breakthrough
